observations.behavior: Adds a `parent_offset` and `cursor` field to `DbtResumeConfig` alongside the existing `offset`.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the warehouse ingestion connector to resume mid-page and mid-parent expansion, supporting pagination and cursor-based discovery. This could help PostHog warehouse connectors recover from mid-stream failures without losing progress.

observations.behavior: Adds a new helper `get_discovery_url` to resolve the GraphQL Discovery API URL, supporting user-supplied URLs and region-based defaults, while rejecting insecure schemes.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds a safeguard against SSRF and insecure connections when users supply a custom Discovery API URL. This could help PostHog warehouse connectors avoid misconfiguration or private-network exposure.

observations.behavior: Adds a `discovery_api_url` parameter to `validate_credentials` and calls the new discovery URL resolver.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows warehouse ingestion to carry a user-supplied Discovery API URL through credential validation, supporting environments where the metadata service URL is not derived from the account API.
